notes: B-60(a) regression (2026-10-29). Printed: 'Equip {1} ({1}: Attach to target creature you control. Equip only as a sorcery.)' (CR 702.6a). On the opponent's turn the equip is refused before anything is paid; back on its controller's turn, main phase, empty stack, the same activation attaches (Bearer 2/2 -> 3/3) and spends one of the two colorless. Before the fix the compiler dropped the sorcery timing and the first activation succeeded.
